records.title: Greenfield Petroleum Refinery Project by BPCL in Andhra Pradesh.
details: (a) to (c): The Board of Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) has so far approved initial expenditure for pre-project activities and various studies for a potential Greenfield refinery-cum-petrochemical complex in the State of Andhra Pradesh. Land for the project is yet to be handed over by the Government of Andhra Pradesh to BPCL. BPCL has not finalized detailed cost of the project or partners for investment so far. Investment approval for the project is yet to be accorded by the board of BPCL.

records.title: Infrastructure at Tirupati Bus Terminal.
details: a to d: Upon finalization of the design, the project will be taken up accordingly in a public-private partnership mode by National Highways Logistics Management Ltd collaboration with the State Government.

records.title: Implementation of Svamitva Scheme
details: e: To ensure timely completion of SVAMITVA Scheme, the Ministry of Panchayati Raj has set targets for drone survey and property cards. The States and Union Territories (UTs) are expected to complete the drone survey by March 2025 and the preparation of property cards for the rural Abadi areas by March 2026.

records.title: PROJECTS UNDER SCM IN THE TIRUPATI
details:
Part (aq); As per the information provided by the Tirupati smart city, work
orders have been issued in 104 projects amounting to a total of
₹2,083 crore under Smart Cities Mission (SCM), of which 79 projects
amounting to ₹1,611 crore have been completed and remaining 25
projects amounting to ₹472 crore are under implementation.

records.title: Credit Guarantee Scheme for MSMEs in Manufacturing Sector
details:
Part (a) to (c): It was announced in Union Budget 2024-25 that for facilitating term loans to
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) for purchase of machinery and equipment,
without collateral or third-party guarantee, a Credit Guarantee Scheme will be introduced. As
informed by Department of Financial Services, the implementation of the Budget announcement
has been taken up.
